Definition of begotten

blocks.html: begotten adjective: brought into existence by or as if by a parent. Merriam Webster Dictionary

blocks.html: The Christian Church teaches that ‘Jesus’ was the only begotten son on Earth through a divine conception to ‘Mary’. This is not the birth indicated by the word begotten; the term begotten is not referring to Yahushua’s human birth to Yoseph and Maryam; but rather his birth into full sonship to יהוה. It is referring to Yahushua’s resurrection into The Kingdom of יהוה. Whenever speaking of his human birth in the flesh the word born is used not begotten.

blocks.html: The term "only begotten son" simply means Yahushua at this time and until such time as the first resurrection is the ONLY begotten (resurrected) son of יהוה in the family. Yahushua was the FIRST FRUITS (resurrected the first fruits of many more to come on the first Shabbat after Passover then his presenting the first fruits of the resurrection to the Father the next day on the Feast of First Fruits).

blocks.html: 1 Sha’ul, an apostle of Messiah Yahushua by the will of יהוה, to the assembly of sons which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in (covenant with) Messiah Yahushua: 2 Grace be to you, and peace, from יהוה our Father, and from the King Messiah Yahushua. 3 Blessed be the Elohim (declaration of the Shema) and Father of our King Messiah Yahushua (his is not Elohim incarnate), who (יהוה) have blessed us (his sons) with all spiritual blessings in The Kingdom of יהוה in (covenant with) Yahushua: 4 According (to יהוה’s purpose) as He (יהוה) has chosen (predestined) us in Him (self) before the foundation of the world (through His Plan of Salvation), that we should be set-apart and without blame before Him (יהוה ) in love (through covenant): 5 Having predesignated (according to His Plan of Salvation) us unto the adoption of children (יהוה’s plan to beget a family) by (the blood sacrifice of) Messiah Yahushua (as Passover Lamb) to himself (one through marriage covenant), according to the good pleasure of His (יהוה’s) will (to beget a family of Elohim to govern His creation), 6 To the praise of the glory of His (יהוה’s) grace, wherein He has (through blood sacrifice of Messiah) made us accepted in the beloved (family of יהוה).

Sha’ul did an outstanding job of explaining exactly what יהוה set out to do and where Yahushua fits in and where, we the rest of His sons, are destined within the Plan of יהוה.
